name: tr_eval
statement: eval (TM2.step tr) (init c v) = halt <$> Code.eval c v

name: trStmts₁_supports
statement: (q : Λ').Supports S) (HS₁ : trStmts₁ q ⊆ S) : Supports (trStmts₁ q) S

name: codeSupp'_supports
statement: codeSupp c k ⊆ S) : Supports (codeSupp' c k) S

have_tree.name: H'
have_tree.body: H; simp only [codeSupp_cons, Finset.union_subset_iff] at H'

have_tree.name: H'
have_tree.body: H; rw [codeSupp_comp] at H'; have H' := Finset.union_subset_right H'

have_tree.name: H'
have_tree.body: H; simp only [codeSupp_case, Finset.union_subset_iff] at H'

have_tree.name: H'

name: contSupp_supports
statement: contSupp k ⊆ S) : Supports (contSupp k) S

have_tree.name: H₁
have_tree.body: H; rw [contSupp_cons₁] at H₁; have H₂ := Finset.union_subset_right H₁
